description: This file defines a Response class for handling API responses in JSON format within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for formatting data and errors, and contains constants related to content types.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class for constructing and formatting API response data in JSON format, including data, metadata, and relationships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing response data, metadata, and relationships arrays.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the data formatted as a JSON string.

methods.name: formatData
methods.description: Returns the complete response with data, metadata, and relationships formatted as a JSON string.

methods.name: formatError
methods.description: Static method to encode an error C array as a JSON string.
